channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Tigers ousted on Jaguars buzzer-beater, 92-90
item.description: Rocky Mount Prep beats Wilson Prep 92-90 on a buzzer-beater in the 1-A playoffs, ending the Tigers’ turbulent, shorthanded season at 13-13 despite big nights from Qua Batts and Trey Atkinson.

item.title: Wilson Prep girls annihilate RMP 80-13 in 1-A second round
item.description: No. 2 Wilson Prep routed Rocky Mount Prep 80-13 in the NCHSAA 1-A second round, forcing a running clock and advancing to face Washington County behind MyAngel Brimage’s 20 points.

item.title: Church news: Congregations gather for weekly services
item.description: Area churches announce upcoming services, revivals, installations and special events.

item.title: What critics still get wrong about marijuana legalization
item.description: Cannabis re-legalization is a work in progress. But it’s here to stay — and by and large, we’re mostly getting it right.

item.title: No one dreams of earning a college degree under wiretap conditions
item.description: UNC-Chapel Hill’s new policy allowing secret classroom recordings is driving faculty away, chilling debate and raising alarms about tech-enabled harassment and the future of public higher education in North Carolina.

item.title: Hidden taxes: The housing affordability crisis is math, not politics
item.description: As inflation eases, a Carolina Journal Poll shows NC Republicans still feel overtaxed, while builders warn tariffs on key materials act as hidden taxes driving housing costs higher.

item.title: Wilson launches search for new police chief
item.description: Wilson is still searching for a new police chief after Benny Boykin’s Feb. 1 retirement.

item.title: Accidental fire displaces resident
item.description: Accidental fire damages Wilson multi-family home; one resident displaced, no injuries reported as 6 fire units and 19 firefighters respond Thursday evening, causing an estimated $9,500 in damage.

item.title: Immediate care integrates with Wilson Physician Services
item.description: Wilson Immediate Care is joining Wilson Physician Services March 1, briefly closing March 1–9 before reopening March 10 with the same staff, services and expanded hours for urgent and occupational care.

item.title: ‘This is my last Hail Mary’: Homeowner fights looming demolition
item.description: With home demolition days away, former Wilson preservation planner Lu-Ann Monson pleads for time to save her 1893 home, saying the city has singled her out and iced her out.
